lines.text: I used to wait for someone else to turn the spotlight on
I used to dim myself so nobody would feel wrong
But the light I was chasing was already inside of me
I just had to stop running and finally let it be
I’m not asking permission anymore
I’m stepping into what was mine before
Own the glow, let it shine out loud
I earned every ray, I’m not hiding now
This is my afterglow, this is my light
Own the glow — I’m done with the night
Every scar I carry is a story I get to tell
Every time I stood back up, I learned I do it well
I don’t need to prove I’m worthy of the space I take
I’m owning every inch of the woman I became
I’m not asking permission anymore
I’m stepping into what was mine before
Own the glow, let it shine out loud
I earned every ray, I’m not hiding now
This is my afterglow, this is my light
Own the glow — I’m done with the night
This light isn’t borrowed, it isn’t on loan
It’s mine because I fought for it and made it on my own
[Final Chorus] (building layers)
Own the glow, let it shine out loud
I earned every ray, I’m not hiding now
This is my afterglow, this is my light
Own the glow — watch me burn bright
